verdict.rationale: Bruno ships a built-in assistant, Bruno AI, that takes delegated tasks inside the app. It generates pre/post scripts, tests and docs from a description, offers an AI Chat Sidebar reachable from anywhere in the workspace, and can build a complete App from the open request's context. It is BYOK and supports custom OpenAI-compatible providers. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the assistant's quality, and evidence of autonomous multi-step agentic execution beyond generate-then-review flows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Click the AI icon, describe what you need, and Bruno generates a script.
The AI Chat Sidebar lets you ask questions and get AI assistance directly from anywhere in your workspace, without needing to open a specific request first.
Open the Tests tab, click the AI icon, and describe what to assert. Bruno generates test code that you can review before accepting.
Open the Docs tab, click the AI icon, and describe the endpoint or workflow. Bruno writes the documentation for you to review and accept.
Bruno AI understands the context of your open request or collection and can generate a complete working App for you.
